name: browserpilot
description: A local browser control bridge for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Connect Codex, Claude Code, and MCP clients to your real Chrome browser.
interface.longDescription: BrowserPilot is a local browser control bridge with tab claiming, visible DOM inspection, node-based interaction, screenshots, long screenshots, scheduled tasks, and MCP tools for multiple AI agents.
